subject: Compliance discovery — evidence tracker & scope confirmation
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@finasset.com>, Timothy Smith <tim.s@finasset.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-31T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Compliance discovery — evidence tracker & scope confirmation

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from my side and concrete next steps so we’re all aligned. Please reply with any corrections.

Key pain points discussed
- Audit log retention: FinAsset needs per-tenant immutable audit logs for 7 years; must support export by request.
- SOC 2 boundary: they want clarity on whether Redwood hosts logs and whether our SOC 2 covers dedicated deployments / VPC private controls.
- DPA & data residency: legal is asking for DPA language that commits to log retention windows and access controls.
- Pen test evidence: procurement will want a summary of recent pen tests, remediation timelines, and whether tests covered the private offering.

Goals from FinAsset
1) Confirm what artifacts we can provide by next Friday (9/4): SOC 2 summary + control matrix, audit log schema + retention options, pen test summary.
2) Get a DPA redline baseline they can circulate to legal.
3) Agree on a short intake path so they can score us for procurement this month.

Agreed next steps (our asks)
- I’ll send a SOC 2 scope matrix and a DPA draft for their legal to review (attached: SOC2-Scope-Matrix.xlsx; redwood-dpa-draft-20260831.docx).
- Elena / Tim will confirm whether 7-year retention is a hard requirement vs. a negotiable target and will share any internal retention policy excerpts they can.
- We will provide a pen test summary (we can share a stub now and full report under NDA).

Proposed timeline
- 9/1: FinAsset confirms retention requirement and any required certification evidence.
- 9/3: Redwood to consolidate artifacts and provide a single intake link + Drive folder.
- 9/10: Target for legal DPA redline exchange (flexible).

Attachments referenced
- SOC2-Scope-Matrix.xlsx (control mapping + whether hosted / dedicated / private covered)
- redwood-dpa-draft-20260831.docx (initial DPA language; note we will highlight log/retention clauses)
- pen-test-summary-stub.pdf (high-level findings; full under NDA)

If that matches your read, Elena — can you confirm the retention (7 years) is a hard blocker and whether procurement requires vendor-hosted logs or customer-managed exports? Also, do you want the SOC 2 summary anonymized or tenant-specific excerpts?

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0199

---

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@finasset.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Timothy Smith <tim.s@finasset.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance discovery — evidence tracker & scope confirmation

Chloe — appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side after reviewing internally this morning.

On retention: 7 years is the target from Risk; Legal called it a "preferred requirement" but said they can accept a combination of vendor retention + customer export tooling if we can demonstrate immutable, tamper-evident audit logs and a documented export/restore playbook.

On SOC 2: we need explicit confirmation that the SOC 2 report covers your hosted API and any dedicated capacity option we might reserve. If the private VPC deployment requires different controls, please highlight those gaps. Tenant-specific excerpts are fine — Procurement wants to see how controls map to our dataflows.

On pen test: Procurement is okay with a redacted executive summary in the first pass; they will ask for full findings under NDA if we progress.

We will:
- Confirm retention policy language by EOD 9/1 (I will send a short note from Risk with the precise wording).
- Share any legal constraints on DPA language (we generally mark up vendor DPAs; our default requires explicit log retention clauses).

Quick Q: do you have a standard cryptographic hash / integrity proof approach for audit exports (e.g., signed manifests)? That would make procurement happier. If yes, please call that out in the SOC2-Scope-Matrix.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Procurement & Risk | FinAsset
elena@finasset.com

On Tue, Aug 31, 2026 at 3:04 PM Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks again for taking time today...

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-01T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Compliance discovery — evidence tracker & scope confirmation

Looping you both in — FinAsset pushed back slightly on retention (7 years preferred but can accept vendor retention + export as long as integrity proofs exist). They also want SOC 2 coverage explicitly called out for hosted + dedicated. Procurement wants an exec summary of the pen test first, full under NDA.

Action items for Redwood (owner / ETA):
1) Jordan: update SOC2-Scope-Matrix.xlsx to include a column for "deployment coverage" (hosted, dedicated, private) and a short note on integrity proofs for exports (suggest we reference signed manifests + HMAC-based manifests). ETA: 9/3 COB.
2) Jordan: prepare pen-test executive summary (redacted) and a short note on remediation timelines. ETA: 9/3.
3) Marissa: confirm whether we can provide tenant-level log excerpts or if we need a generalized schema + export playbook. Also confirm any commercial impact if FinAsset insists on a 7-year retention SLA (this is likely to affect pricing/ops). ETA: 9/4.
4) Chloe: finalize the DPA draft and highlight the log-retention clauses; send to Elena once Jordan has SOC/pen-test stubs. ETA: 9/3.

Notes about attachments: I attached the current SOC2-Scope-Matrix and a DPA draft for baseline language. Jordan — the SOC2 file has preliminary mappings; please update the deployment coverage and add a short paragraph about manifest signing for exports.

I’ll create a Drive folder and a short intake doc (link below) so we can hand off a single package to FinAsset.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cDEF-gDriveLink
HubSpot: RWI-FA-237

Thanks — Chloe

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Compliance discovery — evidence tracker & scope confirmation

Chloe / Jordan — priority on this one. FinAsset looks like a mid-enterprise opportunity and procurement is already doing heavy compliance gating. A few decisions from my side:

1) Retention SLA: we should avoid a hard 7-year full-SLA when possible. Offer a formal retention + export playbook with integrity proofs as the standard; discuss a priced SLA add-on if they require vendor-managed 7-year retention. Jordan, please model storage/cost delta for a 7-year per-tenant retention and include an ops note (backup, retrieval, immutability).

2) SOC 2 coverage: Jordan, confirm which controls differ across hosted vs. dedicated vs. private. Where gaps exist, flag mitigations we can document for procurement.

3) DPA: Chloe, proceed with the current redline draft but mark the log-retention and export sections as negotiable; we will not auto-accept repo-duration language without pricing.

4) Coordination: Jordan to consolidate artifacts into the Drive folder and create a single ZIP for sharing under NDA. Chloe — include the redacted pen-test exec summary in the first package and note that the full report will be provided post-NDA.

Timelines: target the consolidated package by EOD 9/3 so we can hit FinAsset’s procurement window. If you need headcount to hit that, escalate to me now.

Marissa Cole
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0112
